snippet.title: Empires of the Undergrowth - 1.0 Launch Trailer | RTS Ant Colony-Builder
snippet.description:
Empires of the Undergrowth is available now on Steam, GOG, and Epic Games Store!

Empires of the Undergrowth is a blend of RTS and base-building, where you command a colony of ants against the threats of the insect world, developing pheromone-based tactics centered around the evolution into new ant species. 

➤ OUT NOW ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/463530/Empires_of_the_Undergrowth
➤ OUT NOW ON GOG: https://www.gog.com/en/game/empires_of_the_undergrowth
➤ OUT NOW ON EPIC: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/empires-of-the-undergrowth

Check out all Hooded Horse strategy games:
